definitions.explanation: Metal tools, fittings, and household implements. Includes items such as nails, hinges, knives, pots, and other metal goods.

examples.english: I bought screws at the hardware store.

examples.english: This town has been known as a center of metalwork since long ago, with thriving production of knives and scissors.

notes:
A general term for metal goods, tools, and fittings. The {金物|かなもの}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (hardware store) is a traditional type of shop in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金物|かなもの}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (hardware store)
- {金物|かなもの}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (hardware shop)
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧{金物|かなもの} (construction hardware)
- {金物|かなもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧ (metalwork production area)

Famous {金物|かなもの} production areas in Japan include {三木|みき} (Miki, Hyogo) for tools and {燕三条|つばめさんじょう} (Tsubame-Sanjo, Niigata) for cutlery and kitchen items.
